free_text: The decision to recommend biopsy is strongly supported by the combination of elevated PSA (14.0 ng/mL) and highly suspicious imaging findings (PI-RADS 4). This is further emphasized by the decisive variable weight assigned to the PSAD score of 0.734 and the physical finding of a nodular DRE. Therefore, a biopsy is indicated to evaluate the suspicious lesion identified on MRI.
